title: feature request 2.8.2 amend "record Bolus only" to calculator
symptom: The user requests that the 'record only Bolus' tick box from the Insulin Input screen also be added to the calculator, to allow calculating an external bolus and recording it without switching screens, avoiding mistakes.
evidence_quote: could you please amend the "record only Bolus" tick box of the Insulin Input screen also to the calculator.
